name: jlab_order_queue
description: Limits a physician to one ROUTINE JLab lab order per patient per local calendar day, deferring extras in FIFO order via a Command Validation block on the order's own Sign action. STAT/URGENT orders always bypass the queue. The physician always performs the actual signature -- this plugin never signs, cancels, or deletes a clinical order.

handlers.description: Maintains the routine-lab-order queue in real time: origination, validation-time signing block, commit, update, delete, and enter-in-error.
Every 5 minutes, promotes deferred orders whose eligible date has arrived (catches local-midnight rollover with no other triggering event).
Staff-session-authenticated HTTP API serving the queue page and its JSON data, for both the global and patient-specific applications.

applications.name: JLab Order Queue
applications.description: View and filter every patient's JLab routine lab order queue.
